**Opening:** `game-console.component.ts:237` `openInventory()` calls `MatDialog.open(InventoryComponent, { data, panelClass: 'inv-dialog-panel', maxHeight: '90vh' })` (line 242), triggered by the Inventory button (`game-console.component.html:9`).

**Data passed:** `InventoryDialogData = { characterId, sessionId }` (`inventory.component.ts:19`), injected via `MAT_DIALOG_DATA`.

**API calls it can make** (via `GameApiService`, `game-api.service.ts`):
- `getInventory` → `GET /api/character/:id` (load, on init)
- `equipItem` → `PATCH /api/character/:id/equip` (equip/unequip)
- `dropItem` → `DELETE /api/character/:id/inventory/:itemId` (use potion, drop item)

Note: potion healing is computed client-side and never persisted (B-05); equipment is display-only, ignored by combat (B-08).
